title: A 2,000+ tool catalog in a fixed schema budget
subtitle: Search first, reveal bounded schemas, re-check access at call time

messages.label: discovery: follow every tools/list page (bound: 10,000 tools/server)
complete catalog — a partial page sequence fails, never truncates
index server + tool + schema text, within the agent's access
needs a tool: query by keyword
matches with schemas — at most 32 active tools / 64 KiB
revealed schemas join the tool list next step
call the tool (authority checked again at call time)

messages.text: If matches do not fit one result, search asks the model to narrow the query instead of truncating
